INSERT INTO role_default_widgets (role_id, widget_id, cell_index) SELECT r.id, w.id, d.cell_index FROM (VALUES ('ADMIN', 'PROCUREMENT_BY_STAGE', 22),
('MANAGER', 'UPCOMING_DELIVERIES', 26), ('MANAGER', 'PROCUREMENT_BY_STAGE', 32),
('FOREMAN', 'UPCOMING_DELIVERIES', 22),
('BUYER', 'POSITIONS_WITH_BUYER', 0), ('BUYER', 'PROCUREMENT_BY_STAGE', 2), ('BUYER', 'UPCOMING_DELIVERIES', 4) ) AS d(role_code, widget_code, cell_index) JOIN roles r ON r.code = d.role_code JOIN dashboard_widgets w ON w.code = d.widget_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_default_widgets x WHERE x.role_id = r.id AND x.widget_id = w.id ) ON CONFLICT (role_id, cell_index) DO NOTHING;
